title: Prevent duplicate-line inventory oversell and invalid reservations
summary: Aggregate duplicate SKU lines before comparing requested inventory with available stock; reject invalid quantities and direct helper over-reservation.
Add regression coverage for duplicate demand, invalid quantities and direct helper guards; the complete suite passes 12 tests, type checking and the client build.
Add nine source-linked learning guides, an exact original rule snapshot, worked practice solutions and actual verification evidence.
behavior: Two lines for one SKU are summed before the availability comparison.
Zero, negative, fractional, non-finite, and unsafe integer quantities return validation failures from planReservation.
applyReservation rejects invalid quantities and quantities above available-to-promise stock.
Existing valid reservation, shipment, and low-stock behavior remains covered by the domain suite.

checks.command: npm ci; npm run db:generate; npm run db:push; npm run db:seed; npm test; npm run typecheck; npm run build
checks.environment: Node 22.16; npm 10.9.2; disposable staged SQLite with absolute DATABASE_URL

recordedChecks.label: full-test-absolute
recordedChecks.database: Disposable staged SQLite database at prisma/dev.db, supplied through an absolute DATABASE_URL.

limits: Nine pure inventory rule tests and three API health/read/export tests pass. The API suite does not execute reservation writes or prove persistent reservation atomicity.
Duplicate demand and direct helper boundaries are covered; concurrent reservations and invalid stored balance data require separate integration work.
The existing db:push script resets prisma/dev.db and the seed deletes existing rows. Verification used only a disposable staged database.
No browser workflow, deployed environment or external integration was exercised.
